scope: Windows host IPsec login preparation only; router operations and UI unchanged

rounds.focus: Native script syntax and text decoding
evidence: Microsoft netsh command documentation pinned to commit 4282dd47a285a65de44c1512e8e9abd2384582a8
Local Microsoft netsh static add rule ? help permits repeated rootca parameters
rounds.finding: The old parser rejected repeated rootca even in unrelated existing rules. This is a valid native syntax, not a decoding failure.
rounds.change: Do not retain or treat authentication-only rootca/psk parameters as unique semantic selectors; continue rejecting duplicate ports, addresses and policy associations.
rounds.validation: Independent duplicate-certificate fixtures; first and repeat login pass; wrong endpoint and duplicate critical fields still fail.

rounds.focus: Exact allow scope, identity preservation and rollback
evidence: Existing registry preservation implementation and prior protocol source cross-check
rounds.finding: No evidence supports widening the permit scope or bypassing verification. Snapshot checks and owned-object rollback remain necessary.
rounds.change: No changes to policy selection, service state, destination masks, ports, policy assignment or rollback semantics.
rounds.validation: Existing transaction, original-node preservation, concurrent-change, backup failure, partial-command failure and receipt-failure regressions pass.

rounds.focus: Process results, IPC and diagnostic export
evidence: Actual administrator worker and exported diagnostic sanitizer call chain
rounds.finding: Failures before backup lost native exit codes; exported logs lacked per-command outcome and output-size metadata.
rounds.change: Add at most 12 command metadata rows, including fixed operation code, outcome, return code, elapsed milliseconds and output bytes; retain pre-backup errors through administrator IPC; never export command arguments or output.
rounds.validation: Metadata whitelist, bounded retention, timeout, capture failure, pre-backup error, final-verification rollback, login export, cancellation and session regressions pass.

customer_evidence.observed: Three attempts stopped after four IPsec additions, failed final verification, verified rollback; SSH authentication was not reached.
customer_evidence.unknown: No raw dump or failing field in original export. Repeated certificates and tunnel=no are compatibility findings, not proven causes for this customer.

validation.native_calls: Read-only netsh add filter ? and add rule ? only

performance: No extra policy calls, polling or timers; metadata collection uses fixed-size rows and a 12-entry cap; existing output limits and process cleanup retained.
delivery: Source and offline validation only; no application package, publication or customer-machine success claimed.
